text: Android: copy a list into another account or the local area (B4)

From the B2 review: the removal dialog already says lists to keep can be copied to another account first; B4 makes that true and, with B3 present, the wording must name the local area. Also: OverviewViewModel.joinInvite/RedeemViewModel get a shared invite helper in the B2 follow-ups; copy should not add a third copy of that shape.
